Hypertext Editor

A zero-bloat, Notion-grade WYSIWYG document editor with inline resizable HyperSheet tables, 2D arrow key navigation, Alt + ↑/↓/←/→ row & column splitters, document right-click context menu, and Levenshtein auto-fix spellchecker.

Welcome to Hypertext Editor

Hypertext Editor is an ultra-lean, hypermedia-driven rich text suite designed for modern web applications. It replaces heavy WYSIWYG packages with zero external dependencies.

💡 ProTip: Type / on any empty line for slash commands, or Right-Click anywhere for the document context menu!

Inline Resizable HyperSheet Table

Navigate cells with ↑ / ↓ / ← / →. Press Alt + ↓ to add a row below, or Alt + → to add a column. Drag column & row border handles to resize.

HyperSheet Resizable Matrix
Shortcuts: Alt+↑/↓/←/→

Designed for Fullstack Developers

Everything you type synchronizes instantly into hidden form fields and updates telemetry in real-time.

  • Zero React, zero ProseMirror, zero bloat
  • Sub-millisecond signal updates via htmx-bolt
  • Native 1:1 Go DSL for server-side HTML rendering

HTMX Form Integration

Hypertext Editor connects directly to standard HTMX forms. It updates a hidden content_html payload on every change. 

<!-- HTMX Form Submission -->
<form hx-post="/api/posts/create" hx-target="#post-feedback" class="space-y-4">
  <input type="text" name="title" placeholder="Post Title..." class="w-full px-4 py-2 border rounded-lg">
  
  <!-- Drop-in Hypertext Editor -->
  <div hx-ext="reactive" ...>
    <input type="hidden" name="content_html" id="hypertext-hidden-input">
  </div>

  <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold">
    Publish Article →
  </button>
</form>

Go DSL Usage

import "github.com/hyperlibs/HTMX PRO/go/components"

// Server-rendered Hypertext Editor with inline HyperSheet table
editor := components.HypertextEditor(components.HypertextEditorProps{
    Name:        "article_body",
    Placeholder: "Write your document...",
    InitialHTML: "<h1>My Notes</h1><p>Start writing here...</p>",
    MinHeight:   "350px",
})

          <div id="ctx-table-group" class="space-y-0.5 pb-1 border-b border-border/60">
            <div class="px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary">Table Actions</div>
            <button type="button" onclick="ctxTableAction('row-above')" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span>➕ Insert Row Above</span>
              <kbd class="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">Alt+↑</kbd>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="ctxTableAction('row-below')" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span>➕ Insert Row Below</span>
              <kbd class="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">Alt+↓</kbd>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="ctxTableAction('col-left')" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span>➕ Insert Col Left</span>
              <kbd class="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">Alt+←</kbd>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="ctxTableAction('col-right')" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span>➕ Insert Col Right</span>
              <kbd class="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">Alt+→</kbd>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="ctxTableAction('del-row')" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-left">
              <span>🗑️ Delete Row</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="ctxTableAction('del-col')" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-left">
              <span>🗑️ Delete Column</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="pt-1 space-y-0.5">
            <div class="px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Document Format</div>
            <button type="button" onclick="execStyle('bold'); closeContextMenu();" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span><strong>B</strong> Bold</span>
              <kbd class="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">Ctrl+B</kbd>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="execStyle('italic'); closeContextMenu();" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span><em>I</em> Italic</span>
              <kbd class="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">Ctrl+I</kbd>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="insertCallout('tip'); closeContextMenu();" class="w-full flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span>💡 Insert Callout</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="insertInlineHyperSheetTable(); closeContextMenu();" class="w-full flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-foreground">
              <span>📊 Insert Table</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="autoFixTypography(); closeContextMenu();" class="w-full flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent text-left text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
              <span>✅ Auto-Fix Typography</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="border-t border-border bg-muted/20 px-4 py-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-4">

    #hypertext-canvas code { background-color: hsl(var(--muted)); padding: 0.15rem 0.35rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.85em; }

    .col-resize-handle { user-select: none; }
    .row-resize-handle { user-select: none; }
  </style>

world worry worth would write writer writing wrong yard year years yellow yes yesterday yet you young your yourself zone";

    const DICTIONARY_WORDS = new Set(WORD_LIST_STR.split(' '));
    const ALPHABET = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';

    const typoDictionary = [
      [/\bteh\b/g, 'the'], [/\bTeh\b/g, 'The'],
      [/\brecieve\b/g, 'receive'], [/\bRecieve\b/g, 'Receive'],
      [/\brecieving\b/g, 'receiving'], [/\bRecieving\b/g, 'Receiving'],
      [/\brecieved\b/g, 'received'], [/\bRecieved\b/g, 'Received'],
      [/\bseperate\b/g, 'separate'], [/\bSeperate\b/g, 'Separate'],
      [/\bseperated\b/g, 'separated'], [/\bSeperated\b/g, 'Separated'],
      [/\bdefinately\b/g, 'definitely'], [/\bDefinately\b/g, 'Definitely'],
      [/\boccured\b/g, 'occurred'], [/\bOccured\b/g, 'Occurred'],
      [/\boccuring\b/g, 'occurring'], [/\bOccuring\b/g, 'Occurring'],
      [/\buntill\b/g, 'until'], [/\bUntill\b/g, 'Until'],
      [/\bwierd\b/g, 'weird'], [/\bWierd\b/g, 'Weird'],
      [/\btruely\b/g, 'truly'], [/\bTruely\b/g, 'Truly'],
      [/\baccomodate\b/g, 'accommodate'], [/\bAccomodate\b/g, 'Accommodate'],
      [/\bgoverment\b/g, 'government'], [/\bGoverment\b/g, 'Government'],
      [/\bacheive\b/g, 'achieve'], [/\bAcheive\b/g, 'Achieve'],
      [/\bcalender\b/g, 'calendar'], [/\bCalender\b/g, 'Calendar'],
      [/\btommorow\b/g, 'tomorrow'], [/\bTommorow\b/g, 'Tomorrow'],
      [/\bneccessary\b/g, 'necessary'], [/\bNeccessary\b/g, 'Necessary'],
      [/\bexistense\b/g, 'existence'], [/\bExistense\b/g, 'Existence'],
      [/\bappearence\b/g, 'appearance'], [/\bAppearence\b/g, 'Appearance'],
      [/\bpossession\b/g, 'possession'],
      [/\bpossess\b/g, 'possess'],
      [/\bhtmxui\b/g, 'HTMX PRO'], [/\bHtmxui\b/g, 'HTMX PRO'],
      [/\bhtmxpro\b/g, 'HTMX PRO'], [/\bHtmxpro\b/g, 'HTMX PRO'],
      [/\bhtmx\b/g, 'HTMX'], [/\bHtmx\b/g, 'HTMX']
    ];

    let lastAutoFixSnapshot = null;
    let activeContextTd = null;

    // --- 2D Keyboard Navigation & Alt+Arrow Shortcuts for Table ---
    function handleTableCellKeydown(e, el) {
      const td = el.closest('td');
      if (!td) return;
      const tr = td.parentElement;
      const tbody = tr.parentElement;
      const table = tbody.closest('table');
      if (!table) return;

      const allTrs = Array.from(tbody.children);
      const rowIndex = allTrs.indexOf(tr);
      const allTdsInRow = Array.from(tr.children).filter(c => c.tagName === 'TD' && c.getAttribute('contenteditable') === 'true');
      const colIndex = allTdsInRow.indexOf(td);

      // --- Alt + Arrow Key Insertions ---
      if (e.altKey) {
        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
          e.preventDefault();
          insertRowAt(table, rowIndex + 1);
          focusTableCell(tbody, rowIndex + 1, colIndex);
          return;
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          e.preventDefault();
          insertRowAt(table, rowIndex);
          focusTableCell(tbody, rowIndex, colIndex);
          return;
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
          e.preventDefault();
          insertColumnAt(table, colIndex + 1);
          focusTableCell(tbody, rowIndex, colIndex + 1);
          return;
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
          e.preventDefault();
          insertColumnAt(table, colIndex);
          focusTableCell(tbody, rowIndex, colIndex);
          return;
        }
      }

      // --- 2D Arrow Navigation ---
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        if (rowIndex < allTrs.length - 1) {
          e.preventDefault();
          focusTableCell(tbody, rowIndex + 1, colIndex);
        }
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        if (rowIndex > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          focusTableCell(tbody, rowIndex - 1, colIndex);
        }
      } else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        if (!e.shiftKey && rowIndex === allTrs.length - 1 && colIndex === allTdsInRow.length - 1) {
          e.preventDefault();
          tableAddRow(table.id);
          focusTableCell(tbody, rowIndex + 1, 0);
        }
      }
    }

    function focusTableCell(tbody, rowIdx, colIdx) {
      const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
      if (rowIdx >= 0 && rowIdx < rows.length) {
        const editableTds = Array.from(rows[rowIdx].children).filter(c => c.tagName === 'TD' && c.getAttribute('contenteditable') === 'true');
        const targetCol = Math.max(0, Math.min(editableTds.length - 1, colIdx));
        if (editableTds[targetCol]) {
          editableTds[targetCol].focus();
          try {
            const range = document.createRange();
            const sel = window.getSelection();
            range.selectNodeContents(editableTds[targetCol]);
            range.collapse(false);
            sel.removeAllRanges();
            sel.addRange(range);
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
    }

    function insertRowAt(table, targetRowIdx) {
      const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
      const colCount = table.querySelectorAll('thead th').length - 2;
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.className = 'hover:bg-muted/20 group relative';
      tr.style.height = '36px';

      let cells = `<td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60 font-mono text-muted-foreground text-center bg-muted/20 select-none relative">
        <span class="row-num"></span>
        <div class="row-resize-handle absolute left-0 right-0 bottom-0 h-1.5 cursor-row-resize hover:bg-primary/50 transition-colors"></div>
      </td>`;
      for (let i = 0; i < colCount; i++) {
        cells += `<td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60" contenteditable="true" onkeydown="handleTableCellKeydown(event, this)">-</td>`;
      }
      cells += `<td class="p-2 text-center"><button type="button" onclick="tableDeleteRow(this)" class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-destructive text-xs hover:underline">🗑</button></td>`;

      tr.innerHTML = cells;

      const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
      if (targetRowIdx >= rows.length) {
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      } else {
        tbody.insertBefore(tr, rows[targetRowIdx]);
      }

      renumberTableRows(table);
      initTableResizers(table);
      syncEditorState();
    }

    function insertColumnAt(table, targetColIdx) {
      const theadTr = table.querySelector('thead tr');
      const allThs = Array.from(theadTr.children);
      const colLetter = String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.min(25, targetColIdx));

      const th = document.createElement('th');
      th.style.width = '180px';
      th.className = 'p-2 border-r border-border/60 font-semibold text-foreground relative select-none';
      th.innerHTML = `<span>Col (${colLetter})</span><div class="col-resize-handle absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-primary/50 transition-colors"></div>`;

      // Target th index is targetColIdx + 1 (after row index th)
      const refTh = allThs[targetColIdx + 1] || theadTr.lastElementChild;
      theadTr.insertBefore(th, refTh);

      // Insert Td in all rows
      const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
      rows.forEach(tr => {
        const td = document.createElement('td');
        td.className = 'p-2 border-r border-border/60';
        td.setAttribute('contenteditable', 'true');
        td.setAttribute('onkeydown', 'handleTableCellKeydown(event, this)');
        td.innerText = '-';
        const allTds = Array.from(tr.children);
        const refTd = allTds[targetColIdx + 1] || tr.lastElementChild;
        tr.insertBefore(td, refTd);
      });

      initTableResizers(table);
      syncEditorState();
    }

    function renumberTableRows(table) {
      const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
      rows.forEach((r, i) => {
        const numEl = r.querySelector('.row-num') || r.querySelector('td:first-child');
        if (numEl) {
          if (numEl.querySelector('.row-num')) numEl.querySelector('.row-num').innerText = String(i + 1);
          else if (numEl.firstChild) numEl.firstChild.nodeValue = String(i + 1);
        }
      });
    }

    function tableAddRow(tableId) {
      const table = document.getElementById(tableId);
      if (!table) return;
      const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
      insertRowAt(table, tbody.querySelectorAll('tr').length);
    }

    function tableAddColumn(tableId) {
      const table = document.getElementById(tableId);
      if (!table) return;
      const colCount = table.querySelectorAll('thead th').length - 2;
      insertColumnAt(table, colCount);
    }

    function tableDeleteRow(btn) {
      const tr = btn.closest('tr');
      const table = tr?.closest('table');
      if (tr) {
        tr.remove();
        if (table) renumberTableRows(table);
        syncEditorState();
      }
    }

    function insertInlineHyperSheetTable() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('hypertext-canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;

      const tableId = `table-${Date.now()}`;
      const html = `
        <div class="my-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-3 shadow-xs not-prose select-text" contenteditable="false" id="${tableId}-container">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-2 border-b border-border/60 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-foreground">
              <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary inline-block"></span>
              <span>HyperSheet Matrix</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
              <span class="text-muted-foreground">Shortcuts: <kbd class="px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-muted font-mono">Alt+↑/↓/←/→</kbd></span>
              <button type="button" onclick="tableAddColumn('${tableId}')" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted hover:bg-accent text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground transition-colors">+ Add Col</button>
              <button type="button" onclick="tableAddRow('${tableId}')" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted hover:bg-accent text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground transition-colors">+ Add Row</button>
              <button type="button" onclick="this.closest('#${tableId}-container').remove(); syncEditorState();" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-[11px]">✕ Delete</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table id="${tableId}" class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs table-fixed">
              <thead>
                <tr class="border-b border-border bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                  <th style="width: 44px;" class="p-2 border-r border-border/60 text-center select-none relative">#</th>
                  <th style="width: 200px;" class="p-2 border-r border-border/60 font-semibold text-foreground relative select-none">
                    <span>Column A</span>
                    <div class="col-resize-handle absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-primary/50 transition-colors"></div>
                  </th>
                  <th style="width: 200px;" class="p-2 border-r border-border/60 font-semibold text-foreground relative select-none">
                    <span>Column B</span>
                    <div class="col-resize-handle absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-primary/50 transition-colors"></div>
                  </th>
                  <th style="width: 60px;" class="p-2 text-center select-none">Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-border/40">
                <tr class="hover:bg-muted/20 group relative" style="height: 36px;">
                  <td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60 font-mono text-muted-foreground text-center bg-muted/20 select-none relative">
                    1
                    <div class="row-resize-handle absolute left-0 right-0 bottom-0 h-1.5 cursor-row-resize hover:bg-primary/50 transition-colors"></div>
                  </td>
                  <td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60" contenteditable="true" onkeydown="handleTableCellKeydown(event, this)">Data 1</td>
                  <td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60" contenteditable="true" onkeydown="handleTableCellKeydown(event, this)">Value 1</td>
                  <td class="p-2 text-center"><button type="button" onclick="tableDeleteRow(this)" class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-destructive text-xs hover:underline">🗑</button></td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="hover:bg-muted/20 group relative" style="height: 36px;">
                  <td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60 font-mono text-muted-foreground text-center bg-muted/20 select-none relative">
                    2
                    <div class="row-resize-handle absolute left-0 right-0 bottom-0 h-1.5 cursor-row-resize hover:bg-primary/50 transition-colors"></div>
                  </td>
                  <td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60" contenteditable="true" onkeydown="handleTableCellKeydown(event, this)">Data 2</td>
                  <td class="p-2 border-r border-border/60" contenteditable="true" onkeydown="handleTableCellKeydown(event, this)">Value 2</td>
                  <td class="p-2 text-center"><button type="button" onclick="tableDeleteRow(this)" class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-destructive text-xs hover:underline">🗑</button></td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p><br></p>
      `;

      document.execCommand('insertHTML', false, html);
      initTableResizers(document.getElementById(tableId));
      syncEditorState();
    }

    // --- Column and Row Drag-to-Resize Engine ---
    function initTableResizers(table) {
      if (!table) return;

      // Column Width Resizing
      table.querySelectorAll('.col-resize-handle').forEach(handle => {
        handle.onmousedown = (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          const th = handle.closest('th');
          const startX = e.clientX;
          const startWidth = th.offsetWidth;

          const onMouseMove = (moveEvent) => {
            const dx = moveEvent.clientX - startX;
            const newWidth = Math.max(60, startWidth + dx);
            th.style.width = `${newWidth}px`;
          };

          const onMouseUp = () => {
            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
            document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
            syncEditorState();
          };

          document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
          document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        };
      });

      // Row Height Resizing
      table.querySelectorAll('.row-resize-handle').forEach(handle => {
        handle.onmousedown = (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          const tr = handle.closest('tr');
          const startY = e.clientY;
          const startHeight = tr.offsetHeight;

          const onMouseMove = (moveEvent) => {
            const dy = moveEvent.clientY - startY;
            const newHeight = Math.max(28, startHeight + dy);
            tr.style.height = `${newHeight}px`;
          };

          const onMouseUp = () => {
            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
            document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
            syncEditorState();
          };

          document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
          document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        };
      });
    }

    // --- Right-Click Context Menu Engine ---
    function handleCanvasContextMenu(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const menu = document.getElementById('editor-context-menu');
      const tableGroup = document.getElementById('ctx-table-group');
      if (!menu) return;

      activeContextTd = e.target.closest('td') || e.target.closest('th');

      if (activeContextTd && activeContextTd.closest('table')) {
        tableGroup.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        tableGroup.style.display = 'none';
      }

      // Position context menu
      const posX = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 240, e.clientX);
      const posY = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 300, e.clientY);
      menu.style.left = `${posX}px`;
      menu.style.top = `${posY}px`;
      menu.style.display = 'block';
    }

    function closeContextMenu() {
      const menu = document.getElementById('editor-context-menu');
      if (menu) menu.style.display = 'none';
      activeContextTd = null;
    }

    function ctxTableAction(action) {
      if (!activeContextTd) {
        closeContextMenu();
        return;
      }

      const cell = activeContextTd;
      const tr = cell.closest('tr');
      const table = cell.closest('table');
      if (!table || !tr) {
        closeContextMenu();
        return;
      }

      const theadTr = table.querySelector('thead tr');
      const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
      if (!theadTr || !tbody) {
        closeContextMenu();
        return;
      }

      const allTrs = Array.from(tbody.children);
      const rowIdx = allTrs.indexOf(tr);
      const cellIndex = Array.from(tr.children).indexOf(cell);
      const totalCols = theadTr.children.length; // #, data cols..., Action

      if (action === 'row-above') {
        insertRowAt(table, rowIdx >= 0 ? rowIdx : 0);
      } else if (action === 'row-below') {
        insertRowAt(table, rowIdx >= 0 ? rowIdx + 1 : allTrs.length);
      } else if (action === 'col-left') {
        const targetCol = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalCols - 2, cellIndex > 0 ? cellIndex - 1 : 0));
        insertColumnAt(table, targetCol);
      } else if (action === 'col-right') {
        const targetCol = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalCols - 2, cellIndex > 0 ? cellIndex : 1));
        insertColumnAt(table, targetCol);
      } else if (action === 'del-row') {
        if (allTrs.length > 1) {
          if (rowIdx >= 0) {
            tr.remove();
          } else {
            allTrs[0].remove();
          }
          renumberTableRows(table);
          syncEditorState();
        } else if (allTrs.length === 1) {
          allTrs[0].querySelectorAll('td[contenteditable="true"]').forEach(c => c.innerText = '-');
          syncEditorState();
        }
      } else if (action === 'del-col') {
        if (totalCols <= 3) {
          // Must keep at least 1 data column
          closeContextMenu();
          return;
        }
        let colToDelete = cellIndex;
        if (colToDelete < 1) colToDelete = 1;
        if (colToDelete >= totalCols - 1) colToDelete = totalCols - 2;

        if (theadTr.children[colToDelete]) {
          theadTr.children[colToDelete].remove();
        }
        tbody.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(r => {
          if (r.children[colToDelete]) {
            r.children[colToDelete].remove();
          }
        });
        initTableResizers(table);
        syncEditorState();
      }

      closeContextMenu();
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('#editor-context-menu')) {
        closeContextMenu();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeContextMenu();
      }
    });

    // --- Levenshtein Auto-Fix & Spellchecker Engine ---
    function matchCasing(original, corrected) {
      if (!corrected) return original;
      if (original === original.toUpperCase()) return corrected.toUpperCase();
      if (original[0] === original[0].toUpperCase() && original.slice(1) === original.slice(1).toLowerCase()) {
        return corrected.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + corrected.slice(1).toLowerCase();
      }
      return corrected.toLowerCase();
    }

    function correctWord(originalWord) {
      if (!originalWord || originalWord.length < 3) return originalWord;
      if (originalWord.length <= 5 && originalWord === originalWord.toUpperCase()) return originalWord;

      const lower = originalWord.toLowerCase();
      if (DICTIONARY_WORDS.has(lower)) return originalWord;

      for (let i = 0; i < typoDictionary.length; i++) {
        if (typoDictionary[i][0].test(originalWord)) {
          return originalWord.replace(typoDictionary[i][0], typoDictionary[i][1]);
        }
      }

      const deVoweled = lower.replace(/([aeiou])\1/g, '$1');
      if (DICTIONARY_WORDS.has(deVoweled)) return matchCasing(originalWord, deVoweled);

      const singleLetter = lower.replace(/(.)\1+/g, '$1');
      if (DICTIONARY_WORDS.has(singleLetter)) return matchCasing(originalWord, singleLetter);

      const len = lower.length;
      let candidates = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        const del = lower.slice(0, i) + lower.slice(i + 1);
        if (DICTIONARY_WORDS.has(del)) candidates.push(del);
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < len - 1; i++) {
        const trans = lower.slice(0, i) + lower[i + 1] + lower[i] + lower.slice(i + 2);
        if (DICTIONARY_WORDS.has(trans)) candidates.push(trans);
      }

      if (candidates.length === 0) {
        for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
          for (let j = 0; j < ALPHABET.length; j++) {
            const sub = lower.slice(0, i) + ALPHABET[j] + lower.slice(i + 1);
            if (DICTIONARY_WORDS.has(sub)) candidates.push(sub);
          }
        }
      }

      if (candidates.length > 0) return matchCasing(originalWord, candidates[0]);
      return originalWord;
    }

    function fixSpellingAndSpacing(text) {
      if (!text) return '';
      let res = text;
      res = res.replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, ' ');
      res = res.replace(/ +([,\.!\?;:])/g, '$1');
      res = res.replace(/\(\s+/g, '(').replace(/\s+\)/g, ')');
      res = res.replace(/(\w)--(\w)/g, '$1—$2');
      res = res.replace(/ -- /g, ' — ');
      res = res.replace(/\.{3}/g, '…');
      res = res.replace(/\b([a-zA-Z]{3,})\b/g, (match) => correctWord(match));
      return res;
    }

    function formatBlock(tag) {
      document.execCommand('formatBlock', false, tag);
      syncEditorState();
    }

    function execStyle(cmd) {
      document.execCommand(cmd, false, null);
      syncEditorState();
    }

    function insertCodeInline() {
      const selection = window.getSelection();
      if (!selection.rangeCount) return;
      const text = selection.toString() || 'code';
      document.execCommand('insertHTML', false, `<code>${text}</code>`);
      syncEditorState();
    }

    function insertCallout(type) {
      const html = `<div class="my-4 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 p-4 text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400 text-sm">💡 <strong>Callout:</strong> Write your note here...</div><p><br></p>`;
      document.execCommand('insertHTML', false, html);
      syncEditorState();
    }

    function onEditorInput(el) {
      syncEditorState();
    }

    function onEditorKeydown(e, el) {
      const slashMenu = document.getElementById('slash-menu');
      if (e.key === '/') {
        const state = HxBolt.getState(document.body);
        if (state) state.slashMenuOpen = true;
        slashMenu.style.display = 'block';
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const state = HxBolt.getState(document.body);
        if (state) state.slashMenuOpen = false;
        slashMenu.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    function executeSlashCommand(cmd) {
      const slashMenu = document.getElementById('slash-menu');
      slashMenu.style.display = 'none';
      const state = HxBolt.getState(document.body);
      if (state) state.slashMenuOpen = false;

      document.execCommand('delete', false, null);

      if (cmd === 'h1') formatBlock('h1');
      else if (cmd === 'h2') formatBlock('h2');
      else if (cmd === 'table') insertInlineHyperSheetTable();
      else if (cmd === 'bullet') execStyle('insertUnorderedList');
      else if (cmd === 'callout') insertCallout('tip');
    }

    function syncEditorState() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('hypertext-canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;
      const html = canvas.innerHTML;
      const text = canvas.innerText.trim();
      
      const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('hypertext-hidden-input');
      if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = html;

      const words = text.length > 0 ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
      const chars = text.length;
      const readMin = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words / 200));

      const state = HxBolt.getState(document.body);
      if (state) {
        state.wordCount = words;
        state.charCount = chars;
        state.readingTime = `${readMin} min`;
        state.saveStatus = 'Draft updated';
      }
    }

    function autoFixTypography() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('hypertext-canvas');
      const mdArea = document.getElementById('hypertext-markdown');
      const htmlArea = document.getElementById('hypertext-html');
      const undoBtn = document.getElementById('btn-undo-autofix');

      let activeMode = 'visual';
      if (mdArea && mdArea.style.display !== 'none') activeMode = 'markdown';
      else if (htmlArea && htmlArea.style.display !== 'none') activeMode = 'html';

      lastAutoFixSnapshot = {
        mode: activeMode,
        canvasHTML: canvas ? canvas.innerHTML : '',
        mdValue: mdArea ? mdArea.value : '',
        htmlValue: htmlArea ? htmlArea.value : ''
      };

      if (undoBtn) undoBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';

      if (activeMode === 'visual' && canvas) {
        const walker = document.createTreeWalker(canvas, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
        let node;
        const textNodes = [];
        while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
          if (node.parentElement && (node.parentElement.tagName === 'CODE' || node.parentElement.tagName === 'PRE')) continue;
          textNodes.push(node);
        }

        textNodes.forEach(tNode => {
          tNode.nodeValue = fixSpellingAndSpacing(tNode.nodeValue);
        });

        const paragraphs = Array.from(canvas.querySelectorAll('p'));
        for (let i = paragraphs.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
          const current = paragraphs[i];
          const prev = paragraphs[i - 1];
          if (current.textContent.trim() === '' && prev.textContent.trim() === '' && !current.querySelector('img, hr, iframe')) {
            current.remove();
          }
        }
      } else if (activeMode === 'markdown' && mdArea) {
        let lines = mdArea.value.split('\n');
        let inCode = false;
        lines = lines.map(line => {
          if (line.trim().startsWith('```')) {
            inCode = !inCode;
            return line;
          }
          if (inCode) return line;
          return fixSpellingAndSpacing(line);
        });
        mdArea.value = lines.join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
      } else if (activeMode === 'html' && htmlArea) {
        const temp = document.createElement('div');
        temp.innerHTML = htmlArea.value;
        const walker = document.createTreeWalker(temp, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
        let node;
        const textNodes = [];
        while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
          if (node.parentElement && (node.parentElement.tagName === 'CODE' || node.parentElement.tagName === 'PRE')) continue;
          textNodes.push(node);
        }
        textNodes.forEach(tNode => {
          tNode.nodeValue = fixSpellingAndSpacing(tNode.nodeValue);
        });
        htmlArea.value = temp.innerHTML;
      }

      syncEditorState();

      const state = HxBolt.getState(document.body);
      if (state) {
        state.saveStatus = '✨ Auto-fix applied (spacing, spelling, typography)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (state && state.saveStatus && state.saveStatus.includes('Auto-fix applied')) {
            state.saveStatus = 'All changes saved';
          }
        }, 3500);
      }
    }

    function undoAutoFix() {
      if (!lastAutoFixSnapshot) return;
      const canvas = document.getElementById('hypertext-canvas');
      const mdArea = document.getElementById('hypertext-markdown');
      const htmlArea = document.getElementById('hypertext-html');
      const undoBtn = document.getElementById('btn-undo-autofix');

      if (canvas && lastAutoFixSnapshot.canvasHTML !== undefined) canvas.innerHTML = lastAutoFixSnapshot.canvasHTML;
      if (mdArea && lastAutoFixSnapshot.mdValue !== undefined) mdArea.value = lastAutoFixSnapshot.mdValue;
      if (htmlArea && lastAutoFixSnapshot.htmlValue !== undefined) htmlArea.value = lastAutoFixSnapshot.htmlValue;

      lastAutoFixSnapshot = null;
      if (undoBtn) undoBtn.style.display = 'none';

      syncEditorState();
    }

    function onMarkdownInput(el) { syncEditorState(); }
    function onHtmlInput(el) { syncEditorState(); }

    // Bidirectional Markdown <-> HTML
    function htmlToMarkdown(html) {
      const container = document.createElement('div');
      container.innerHTML = html;

      function walk(node) {
        if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) return node.nodeValue;
        if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return '';

        const tag = node.tagName.toLowerCase();
        const children = Array.from(node.childNodes).map(walk).join('');

        switch (tag) {
          case 'h1': return `\n\n# ${children.trim()}\n\n`;
          case 'h2': return `\n\n## ${children.trim()}\n\n`;
          case 'h3': return `\n\n### ${children.trim()}\n\n`;
          case 'p': return `\n\n${children.trim()}\n\n`;
          case 'strong':
          case 'b': return `**${children}**`;
          case 'em':
          case 'i': return `*${children}*`;
          case 'code':
            if (node.parentElement && node.parentElement.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'pre') return children;
            return `\`${children}\``;
          case 'ul': {
            const items = Array.from(node.children).filter(c => c.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'li').map(c => `- ${walk(c).trim()}`).join('\n');
            return `\n\n${items}\n\n`;
          }
          case 'li': return children;
          default: return children;
        }
      }

      let res = walk(container);
      return res.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
    }

    function inlineMd(str) {
      let res = str;
      res = res.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
      res = res.replace(/\*([^\*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
      res = res.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
      return res;
    }

    function markdownToHtml(md) {
      if (!md) return '<p><br></p>';
      const lines = md.split('\n');
      let html = '';
      let inList = false;

      const flushList = () => {
        if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        let line = lines[i].trim();
        if (!line) { flushList(); continue; }

        if (line.startsWith('# ')) { flushList(); html += `<h1>${inlineMd(line.slice(2))}</h1>`; continue; }
        if (line.startsWith('## ')) { flushList(); html += `<h2>${inlineMd(line.slice(3))}</h2>`; continue; }
        if (line.startsWith('### ')) { flushList(); html += `<h3>${inlineMd(line.slice(4))}</h3>`; continue; }

        if (/^[-*]\s+(.*)$/.test(line)) {
          const match = line.match(/^[-*]\s+(.*)$/);
          if (!inList) { html += '<ul class="list-disc list-inside my-2 space-y-1">'; inList = true; }
          html += `<li>${inlineMd(match[1])}</li>`;
          continue;
        }

        flushList();
        html += `<p>${inlineMd(line)}</p>`;
      }

      flushList();
      return html;
    }

    function switchEditorView(mode) {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('hypertext-canvas');
      const mdArea = document.getElementById('hypertext-markdown');
      const htmlArea = document.getElementById('hypertext-html');

      const btnVisual = document.getElementById('tab-btn-visual');
      const btnMd = document.getElementById('tab-btn-markdown');
      const btnHtml = document.getElementById('tab-btn-html');

      if (mdArea && mdArea.style.display !== 'none' && mdArea.value !== undefined) {
        canvas.innerHTML = markdownToHtml(mdArea.value);
      } else if (htmlArea && htmlArea.style.display !== 'none' && htmlArea.value !== undefined) {
        canvas.innerHTML = htmlArea.value;
      }

      if (mode === 'markdown') {
        mdArea.value = htmlToMarkdown(canvas.innerHTML);
        canvas.style.display = 'none';
        htmlArea.style.display = 'none';
        mdArea.style.display = 'block';
        mdArea.focus();
      } else if (mode === 'html') {
        htmlArea.value = canvas.innerHTML.trim();
        canvas.style.display = 'none';
        mdArea.style.display = 'none';
        htmlArea.style.display = 'block';
        htmlArea.focus();
      } else {
        mdArea.style.display = 'none';
        htmlArea.style.display = 'none';
        canvas.style.display = 'block';
        canvas.focus();
      }

      const activeClass = 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-sm';
      const inactiveClass = 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground';
      [btnVisual, btnMd, btnHtml].forEach(btn => {
        if (btn) btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-all ' + inactiveClass;
      });
      if (mode === 'visual' && btnVisual) btnVisual.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-all ' + activeClass;
      if (mode === 'markdown' && btnMd) btnMd.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-all ' + activeClass;
      if (mode === 'html' && btnHtml) btnHtml.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-all ' + activeClass;

      syncEditorState();
    }

    // Initialize resizers on load
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(t => initTableResizers(t));
    });
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(t => initTableResizers(t));
    }, 100);
  </script>

  <!-- Usage & HTMX Integration Section -->
  <div class="space-y-6 pt-6 border-t border-border">
    <h2 class="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">HTMX Form Integration</h2>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
      Hypertext Editor connects directly to standard HTMX forms. It updates a hidden <code class="bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono">content_html</code> payload on every change.
    </p>

    <div class="code-block"><code><pre>&lt;!-- HTMX Form Submission --&gt;
&lt;form hx-post="/api/posts/create" hx-target="#post-feedback" class="space-y-4"&gt;
  &lt;input type="text" name="title" placeholder="Post Title..." class="w-full px-4 py-2 border rounded-lg"&gt;
  
  &lt;!-- Drop-in Hypertext Editor --&gt;
  &lt;div hx-ext="reactive" ...&gt;
    &lt;input type="hidden" name="content_html" id="hypertext-hidden-input"&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold"&gt;
    Publish Article →
  &lt;/button&gt;
&lt;/form&gt;</pre></code></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Go DSL Usage Section -->
  <div class="space-y-4 pt-6 border-t border-border">
    <h2 class="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">Go DSL Usage</h2>
    <div class="code-block"><code><pre>import "github.com/hyperlibs/HTMX PRO/go/components"

// Server-rendered Hypertext Editor with inline HyperSheet table
editor := components.HypertextEditor(components.HypertextEditorProps{
    Name:        "article_body",
    Placeholder: "Write your document...",
    InitialHTML: "&lt;h1&gt;My Notes&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;Start writing here...&lt;/p&gt;",
    MinHeight:   "350px",
})</pre></code></div>
  </div>
</div>
